label: Two claims, one decision
subgoals: State the null and the alternative

visual.title: Two curves and one rejection region
visual.caption: The null curve is the distribution of the statistic when the null claim is true. Alpha sets the two tail areas that count as evidence against it. The observed statistic and the alternative curve are drawn from the same model.

predict.question: Before seeing the data, what does alpha fix?
options: The total tail area used to reject the null
The probability that the null is true
The observed value of the statistic
predict.explain: Alpha is chosen before the data. It is the Type I error rate, the total area in the two rejection tails when the null is true.
